summary.zh: 点一下，把正在写的草稿变成清晰提示词：确认页先预览，复制或追加随你选。内置 9 套场景预设（写代码 / 代码审查 / 排障 / 写文档 / 写作润色 / 数据与 SQL / 需求与产品 / 学习讲解 / 默认），内容可改、可恢复；另有长度三档、固定模型与其他开关。不发送消息，不额外联网。
summary.en: Tap once: the draft you are writing becomes a sharper prompt, previewed before it touches the composer — copy or append, your call. Nine built-in scene presets (coding, review, debugging, docs, writing, data & SQL, product, learning, default) are all editable and restorable, plus three length tiers, a pinned model and extra switches. Nothing is sent; no extra network calls.
